label: C1: complete derivative systems, totality esse-cause route and the Hume-Edwards rival (#1724)
summary: Issue #1724 (with #1616 scope): C1 = every complete nonempty system of actual derivative beings depends on something underived. Read as C1-bearer it is exactly CCR 20babef7 on the fixed q3a4 ActualEsseCause; C1-anything (an underived fact or law outside the bearer domain) is unformalized, leaves its dependence relation undefined and feeds no root route. A necessary impersonal totality, a universe that is itself an unreceived bearer and priority monism with an unreceived cosmos accept C1-bearer when their whole causes the members' esse, and contest later bridges; a regress or loop with no underived bearer denies it. Derivation attempts: (a) plural non-circularity restricted to complete pluralities restates CCR; without completeness it has the classical minimal-element form of well-foundedness (not formalized; WF implies CCR, 044974e5); no self-causation does not yield it. (b) New verified route, zero-axiom, Comparator/NanoDa: totality cause A 05b15c98 + whole to members B 6c0282c0 + no self-causation b62a64ab give one uncaused cause of every received bearer 9ff2814e (a89fd4df), which gives CCR (50dda707, strength relation 37885377) and, with 457698e4, a576300f, cffad050 and excluded middle, the GOD_4-bundle input da09703b without CCR, population or composition b4987085, whose content moves into B (0773fa6c). The primitive TotalityCause is eliminable (helper jointIffCommonCause): the content is the joint A-and-B claim that one actual bearer causes every received bearer; disambiguation 197f0097 separates the collective sense (A carries it; Hume-Edwards denies A) from the distributive sense 3770b94d (A trivial, B carries it). Seven controls (69ed38fb): joint model with infinite descent; Hume-Edwards regress where no predicate satisfies A and B and the distributive reading satisfies A and fails B; internal loop and idle explainer (B fails); self-causing totality cause; CCR without a common cause on given edges and with two independent roots and no self-causation. The joint claim with no self-causation is strictly stronger than C1 (plural foundations keep C1 and reject it), so the route adds a support option, not independent warrant for CCR. An independent semantic challenge and re-check confirmed the formal core; all prose and disambiguation findings were repaired. Canonical assessment: docs/notes/unique-feedback-explanation-311.md, C1 section.
blocker: No formal blocker; the remaining disagreement is explanatory. Whether actuality by reception is a grounded property (attributions must reach an unreceived giver, least fixed point) or can be satisfied coinductively by an endless or circular system of givers (greatest fixed point); equivalently, whether a complete totality of received actuality is caused in the collective sense or only distributively. The structural tests performed leave both answers consistent. Provisional judgment: C1-bearer at exhaustive per se productive supply scope accepted provisionally as a candidate primitive with recorded warrant, modestly favored, resting mainly on the mode-of-having judgment; the selection asymmetry counts only together with C2 (a source active in every admissible state); unrestricted tenseless mode-unspecified reading underdetermined (#1616 inertia and non-efficient modes, open bridge cb1cdea9); Hume-Edwards and bearerless-primitive-fact denials coherent and not refuted. Reopen for either side on: a positive argument that the collective sense does or does not apply to a complete totality beyond the bare Hume-Edwards denial; a positive account of how a bearerless fact makes bearers actual, or proof that an unreceived act faces the same objection; a same-relation counterexample to B or to no self-causation; a defended per se productive reading of every r-edge or a typed per se model without a source that does not simply deny the groundedness step; a typed mode-specific variant changing the regress control's interpretation.
